daily.today_energy: Mercury in Scorpio is pushing you to think deeper than usual—your ruling planet wants answers, not small talk. With Mars conjunct Jupiter firing up, you're feeling bold and restless. Channel that into something that actually matters.
daily.love: Venus in Libra keeps things balanced and fair-minded. If you've been overthinking a relationship, today's energy supports honest conversations. Your charm is working overtime, but make sure you're not just performing.
daily.career: Mars conjunct Jupiter is basically handing you confidence on a plate. This is the day to pitch that idea or ask for what you deserve. The Sun square Mars might create friction with authority, so keep your approach collaborative, not combative.
daily.health: Moon in Taurus wants you to slow down and actually rest. You're running on fumes under this Mars-Jupiter hype. Ground yourself with something tactile—cooking, walking, literally touching grass. Your nervous system will thank you.
